payload.text: ST0090/02 stays WIP after its landing at a54f2e9e0 until AC-02.4 is met: hv sees the Rebuild Search Index row's second line after a rebuild, on the build that carries WP-01 and WP-02, and vc records which build that was. vc tells hv through devbin-vc which build carries both packages. Then dc closes WP-02 on vc's word; a defect hv sees comes back to dc as a new bank.
